# IKB - recording into this knowledge base

Add to this knowledge base with `ikb RECORD --option value ...`; you need nothing else - not SQL, not the layout of the files.

- A text option takes its text from a file with `@FILE`, or from standard input with `@-` (`--found @-`): long text and apostrophes need no quoting. `@@x` is the text `@x`.
- A record is checked before it is kept; a wrong call says what is wrong and what is accepted, and nothing is changed. A record of an id that exists replaces it.
- After a record `ikb` runs `tad canon` and `tad render` (`--skip-render` to batch several records and run them once), and says one line. Then land your change.
- `--id` is made from the brief when you leave it out; `--date` is today; `--by` is `$OCOECO_BY`.
- `ikb help RECORD` is this section alone; `ikb man` is the man page.

## Records

### `ikb backlog`

An item of work ahead, or done (an item of that id is replaced).

```
ikb backlog --title STRING [--id STRING] [--status STRING] [--note STRING] [--waits STRING] [--about STRING] [--opened DATE]
```

- --id: a-short-name (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --title: what it is
- --status (default open): open, in-progress or done
- --note: where it stands, and the next step
- --waits: what it waits on, if anything
- --about: what it is about (tad q about lists the subjects)
- --opened (date, default today): when it was opened

### `ikb decision`

A decision, with what was rejected and why (a decision of that id is replaced).

```
ikb decision --brief STRING --decision STRING --why STRING [--id STRING] [--rejected STRING] [--about STRING] [--research STRING] [--date DATE]
```

- --id: YYYY-MM-DD-what-was-decided (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --brief: the decision in one line, at most 200 characters: what answers show
- --decision: what was decided
- --why: why: the evidence, whose words
- --rejected: what was weighed and not chosen, and why not
- --about: what it is about (tad q about lists the subjects)
- --research: the research it rests on (its id)
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb research`

What was learned, and from where (a research of that id is replaced). Its finding is the row; its own

```
ikb research --brief STRING --question STRING --found STRING [--id STRING] [--sources STRING] [--about STRING] [--material STRING] [--supersedes STRING] [--date DATE]
```

- --id: a-short-name (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --brief: what was found, in one line of at most 200 characters: what answers show
- --question: what was asked
- --found: what was found, condensed
- --sources: the sources' ids, comma-separated (tad r source records each)
- --about: what it is about (tad q about lists the subjects)
- --material: its folder, research/SUBJECT/YYYY-MM-DD/
- --supersedes: the research it is a later version of (its id)
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb session-log`

How a stretch of work went: what was done, considered and rejected (an entry of that id is replaced).

```
ikb session-log --title STRING --done STRING [--id STRING] [--considered STRING] [--rejected STRING] [--about STRING] [--date DATE]
```

- --id: YYYY-MM-DD-what (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --title: in a few words
- --done: what was done
- --considered: what was considered
- --rejected: what was rejected, and why
- --about: what it is about (tad q about lists the subjects)
- --date (date, default today): when

### `ikb source`

A source research and decisions cite (a source of that id is replaced).

```
ikb source --title STRING --url STRING [--id STRING] [--author STRING] [--year INTEGER] [--by STRING] [--takes STRING]
```

- --id: a-short-name (made from the brief or title when not given)
- --title: its title
- --url: https://...
- --author: who wrote it
- --year (integer): when
- --by: who made what it describes
- --takes: what is taken from it

### `ikb summary`

How a subject stands, in short: written - or renewed in place - when tad q about shows it due. It

```
ikb summary --about STRING --says STRING [--date DATE]
```

- --about: the subject (tad q about lists them, and which are due)
- --says: how it stands, in at most 1500 characters, naming the records that carry it
- --date (date, default today): when

## Asking

Answer from a query, never from `data/` or `docs/`: `tad q NAME --option value` (`--format csv` for long answers).

- `tad q about [--subject] [--whole]` - Everything known of one subject, the short answer first: how it stands (its summary, dated), then what was
- `tad q find --text STRING` - Where something is said: the id and brief of every record that says it, in any case, the latest first.
- `tad q next [--about]` - The work ahead: what is in progress, then what is open, the newest first - with what it is about and
- `tad q recent [--days]` - What was recorded lately, the newest first: decisions, research, work opened and the log, each by its
- `tad q row --id STRING` - One record whole, by its id, from whichever standing table holds it: every field, as JSON (a summary by
